evals.name: working-tree-with-plan-in-context
evals.prompt: Profile: acme (Reviewers: claude, codex; Default branch main). The approved plan is in context and its Steps table ends with the Review, Gates, Approval and Hand-off rows, the Review row's Task reading "Review: <tier> tier × 2", the tier picked by shape. The implementation is done and uncommitted. Run the review.
evals.expected_output: Targets the uncommitted diff, reads <tier> × 2 from the plan's Review row, plans a claude subagent (subagent_type set to that tier) and a codex exec with the model and effort read from the tier's provider file, both in one message, read-only in the shared tree, each given the target line and the absolute path of references/review-prompt.md, then triages into one report.
assertions: Target is the working tree, named with its diff command, not a branch range
Tier and count come from the Task cell of the plan's Review row, not from a question to the user

The dispatch (the launch calls, or the plan of them when the runner has no subagent tool) holds two reviewers in one message: a claude subagent with subagent_type set to the tier picked from ~/.agents/workflow-models/tiers.md by the shape of the work, and a codex command using that tier's model and effort from the provider file; each prompt carries the target line and the absolute path of references/review-prompt.md, not its pasted text
Codex invoked as `codex exec --sandbox read-only` with stdin from /dev/null
No worktree created and no file edited

The report, or its skeleton when a reviewer could not run, has: a count per severity, findings from P1 down each with file:line, impact and fix, a ruled-out list, per-reviewer counts, and the static-review-only line; a missing reviewer shows as a named shortfall, not a clean result

evals.name: pr-target-without-a-plan
evals.prompt: Profile: acme (Reviewers: claude, codex). Review PR 4821 for bugs. No plan file exists for this work, in a Claude Code session.
evals.expected_output: Reads the PR diff through gh, falls back to one reviewer because neither a plan nor the caller supplied tier and count, and reports the fallback it applied.
assertions: PR read through `gh pr diff` / `gh pr view` rather than a checkout, unless a checkout is needed and then only after asking
Falls back to one reviewer at a tier picked from tiers.md by the shape of the work and states that fallback
codex, the first entry from another provider, is the one that runs
No fix applied to the PR branch

evals.name: plan-file-target-contract-gaps
evals.prompt: Profile: acme (Reviewers: claude, codex; Commit policy: direct commits to main). Review ~/.claude/plans/new-cache-layer.md before I approve it — it has no Run heading and its S2 brief edits two files that the S2 row's Files column never lists.
evals.expected_output: Reviews the plan text against the six-section contract, returns the missing Run heading and the two unlisted files as ranked findings, and applies no edit to the plan.
assertions: Target kind is a plan file and reviewers read the plan text, not a code diff
Findings check the six headings in order (Summary, Decisions, Steps, Run, Plan review, Briefs) and flag the missing Run section
Files the brief edits but the row's Files column lacks reported as a finding
Findings ranked P1-P3 and quote headings instead of file:line
The plan file is not edited or completed by this skill

evals.name: single-installed-reviewer-under-count-two
evals.prompt: Profile: a fixture org template whose Reviewers row reads `claude` only. The plan's Review row reads "<tier> tier × 2". Review the working tree.
evals.expected_output: Runs the one installed reviewer, and the report states that a count of 2 yielded one reviewer because the Reviewers row lists only claude.
assertions: Exactly one reviewer runs; codex is not invoked
The shortfall is stated explicitly in the report — count 2 requested, one installed
No reviewer is invented beyond the Reviewers row
The review still completes with a full triaged report

evals.name: codex-stdin-and-tier-mapping
evals.prompt: Profile: acme. Review this branch against main with codex at a mid-scale worker tier.
evals.expected_output: Runs the branch range against main, maps that worker tier to its codex gpt-6-luna model at high effort, and invokes codex read-only with stdin redirected from /dev/null so the call cannot hang.
assertions: Branch range computed from `git merge-base` against the profile's Default branch
Tier and reviewer taken from the caller's words, no plan consulted
`< /dev/null` present on the codex invocation
Model codename mapped from the tiers file, and the actual reviewing model recorded if codex rejects the codename

evals.name: no-repo-review-skill-picked
evals.prompt: Profile: acme, in a repo that ships its own review skill. Review my uncommitted changes for bugs with independent reviewers.
evals.expected_output: Runs the reviewers from the Reviewers row only, leaving any repo-side review skill to the plan that names it.
assertions: Reviewers come from the profile's Reviewers row
No repo-based review skill invoked or recommended as part of this run
Report notes nothing was fixed
